description: South Korea OSM PBF Raw Source

acquisition.reason: provider.url points directly at the .pbf, so the setup script's curl fallback works as-is.
acquisition.note: '-latest' is a MOVING target: re-running downloads whatever Geofabrik published today while data_date above stays pinned, which makes the catalog's provenance wrong. Geofabrik also publishes dated snapshots (south-korea-YYMMDD.osm.pbf) but retains them only a few months — the 2025-12-26 extract this dataset was built from is already gone (404). Reproducing this exact dataset is therefore no longer possible; a fresh extract is close but not identical.
